title: Quantum Frontline Industries secures 2027 follow-on contract for Linza and Zoom drone production for Ukraine
summary: Quantum Frontline Industries (QFI), the German-Ukrainian joint venture between Quantum Systems and Frontline Robotics, has secured a new contract for Linza and Zoom drones from the National Guard of Ukraine, following its initial production program in 2026. The larger follow-on contract comes as QFI significantly expands its manufacturing capacity in Germany for 2027, confirming the joint venture’s ability to bring Ukrainian-developed systems into industrial-scale production.
